about.headline: Bridging Vision, Design, and Engineering
about.body: Hi, I’m Hamdani Harfan—a multidisciplinary Designer, Software Engineer, and banking professional with hands-on experience in the banking industry. I work at the intersection of enterprise-grade reliability, creative problem-solving, and technical execution, transforming complex requirements into seamless, user-centric applications. My expertise spans end-to-end product development: from intuitive UI/UX design and feature specifications to reliable architecture and Google Play Console release management. Whether supporting financial operations in banking or building tools like D-Fin, Dagangku AI, DScan, DStudio, DicteDoc, DTS, and DNotes, my goal is to deliver polished digital experiences that solve real-world problems efficiently.

prompts.title: AI FIGURE STUDIO
prompts.note: Prompt khusus untuk membuat figur action skala 1/7 dengan detail tekstur kulit yang hiper-realistis, lengkap dengan kotak kemasan dan latar studio ZBrush
prompts.prompt: Generate a 1/7 scale collectible figurine of the characters from the provided image, designed in a realistic style and displayed within a real-life setting. The figurine should be positioned on a computer desk and mounted on a clear round acrylic base without any text or markings. On the computer screen, show the ZBrush sculpting process of this same figurine. Beside the monitor, place a toy packaging box in the style of BANDAI, printed with the original artwork. The packaging design should feature flat two-dimensional illustrations. Ensure all details remain consistent with the reference image.

prompts.title: The Poker Legend — Ultra-Realistic Cinematic Photography
prompts.prompt:
A dramatic cinematic portrait of a man sitting at a wooden table inside a dimly lit poker room with rustic wooden walls. Don't change the face of the man. His right hand extended forward as if commanding or tossing playing cards, while his left hand rests under his chin in a thoughtful gesture. Around him, dozens of playing cards float mid-air in dynamic motion blur, frozen in time, creating a sense of magic and mystery.

The background shows warm brown wooden panels, with a framed vintage photo slightly blurred behind him, enhancing the moody atmosphere. Lighting is warm, golden, and low-key, creating sharp contrast and shadows across his face, emphasizing his intense and focused expression.

The overall mood is dark, mysterious, and cinematic, with dramatic composition and shallow depth of field. The image is shot in hyper-realistic style, ultra-detailed textures on skin, hair, wood, and playing cards. The aesthetic is inspired by gritty poker-room vibes, like a mix of magician and gambler, captured with cinematic lighting, bokeh effect, and suspended motion.
prompts.category: Cinematic Portrait / AI Photo Editing / Fantasy / Playing Cards
prompts.note: Gunakan foto referensi dengan wajah yang terlihat jelas. Pertahankan identitas wajah, gaya rambut, dan proporsi asli. Hasil terbaik diperoleh dengan pencahayaan sinematik keemasan, kartu remi melayang yang realistis, serta latar ruangan kayu bernuansa misterius. Cocok untuk foto profil kreatif, konten media sosial, dan karya AI cinematic portrait.

prompts.title: From Photo to Collectible: The Ultimate AI Figure Studio
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic image of one of the people from the reference photo sitting at a computer desk in a real-world environment. The person is holding a 1/7 scale figurine of themselves that looks highly similar to them, crafted in a realistic style. The figurine is placed on a round, transparent acrylic base with no text or markings. On the computer screen in front of them, display the ZBrush modeling process of that same figurine, as if it is actively being sculpted in 3D. With their left hand, the person is also holding a toy packaging box styled like BANDAI products, printed with the original artwork of the character.

The overall scene should emphasize photorealistic textures: realistic skin details, reflections on the acrylic base, natural desk lighting, and authentic materials of the packaging box. The environment should look like a real modern workspace with accurate shadows, depth, and lighting, reinforcing the realism. The mood should feel professional yet creative, as if documenting the production of a high-quality collectible figure.
prompts.category: AI Art / Action Figure / 3D Sculpting / Character Design / Collectible Toys / Photorealistic
prompts.tool: ChatGPT Images / Gemini / AI Image Generator
prompts.note: Ubah foto diri menjadi collectible action figure premium dengan detail wajah realistis, alas akrilik transparan, kemasan eksklusif, dan tampilan proses sculpting 3D di monitor. Gunakan foto referensi dengan wajah yang jelas untuk hasil yang lebih konsisten. Cocok untuk konten personal branding, kreator AI, kolektor figurine, dan portofolio digital.

prompts.title: Lunar Coffee Experience: Menikmati Kopi di Bulan dengan Pemandangan Bumi
prompts.prompt:
A cinematic, ultra-realistic image of a man (use the uploaded face photo and don't change the original face) sitting relaxed on a folding chair placed on the Moon’s rocky surface. He’s dressed in casual streetwear — white shirt, dark pants, and sneakers — holding a cup of hot coffee, steam rising gently into the air. Next to him is an empty folding chair with a small hand coffee grinder resting on it, adding a playful, surreal vibe.

The background reveals a stunning view of Earth rising over the horizon, glowing with vivid blue oceans, green continents, and twinkling city lights visible against the darkness of space. Stars fill the sky, enhancing the otherworldly atmosphere.

Lighting is soft yet dramatic, highlighting the man’s calm expression and the textures of the lunar surface. The scene balances realism with dreamlike qualities — everyday coffee ritual meets cosmic scale. Shot in hyper-detailed, photorealistic style with cinematic depth, sharp textures, and HDR clarity.
prompts.category: AI Art / Cinematic Portrait / Surreal Photography / Space
prompts.note: Ubah foto diri menjadi potret sinematik di permukaan Bulan dengan secangkir kopi dan pemandangan Bumi yang spektakuler. Unggah foto referensi wajah untuk menjaga kemiripan karakter. Cocok untuk konten AI kreatif, personal branding, dan Instagram.

prompts.title: Ultra-Realistic Jet Ski Adventure — Tropical Ocean Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic photo of me riding a jet ski. I must appear exactly the same: sitting on a sleek black-and-orange jet ski, moving fast across the ocean. I’m dressed in a simple long-sleeved black shirt, black shorts, and an orange life vest. A watch is visible on my right wrist. My short black hair is slightly windblown, and I’m smiling naturally (not too wide) while looking toward the camera.

My left hand grips the handlebar, steering the jet ski, while my right hand stretches outward as if playfully reaching toward the seawater — capturing both energy and relaxation. The modern jet ski cuts powerfully through the waves, sending up dramatic splashes as it speeds over the surface.

The shot is taken from a medium-to-distant angle, showing my full body and the entire jet ski clearly. The backdrop is a wide expanse of sea with rolling waves, under a bright blue sky. In the distance, a tropical shoreline is faintly visible.

The style must be ultra-photorealistic, as if shot with a professional DSLR in 4K: crisp textures, realistic skin, natural sunlight, strong shadows, vivid ocean colors, and lifelike proportions. The atmosphere should feel bright, energetic, and immersive, filled with motion and vibrant tropical tones. Output in portrait orientation, 9:16 ratio.
prompts.category: AI Portrait / Jet Ski / Adventure / Ocean / Lifestyle / Photorealistic
prompts.tool: ChatGPT Image Generation / AI Photo Editing
prompts.note: Gunakan foto referensi wajah yang jelas untuk mempertahankan identitas, bentuk wajah, gaya rambut, dan proporsi tubuh. Untuk hasil terbaik, gunakan foto referensi berkualitas tinggi. Pastikan seluruh tubuh dan jet ski terlihat jelas, percikan air tampak realistis, serta tangan dan jari terbentuk secara natural. Format vertikal 9:16, cocok untuk Instagram Reels, TikTok, dan YouTube Shorts.

prompts.title: Yakuza Boss — Cinematic Kabukicho Night Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Convert the uploaded full-body photo into a cinematic Yakuza-themed portrait. The subject should embody the aura of a formidable Japanese crime boss, dressed in a sleek black tailored suit with an open-neck white shirt (no tie). Allow faint glimpses of traditional irezumi tattoos—dragon and koi patterns—emerging naturally from the chest and collar, detailed yet understated. Polished black leather shoes complete the look. The stance should project confidence and quiet menace, with hands resting casually at the sides.

Setting: The backdrop is a Kabukicho alley at night, drenched in neon light from kanji signs, lanterns, and muted streetlamps. Pavement appears wet, mirroring the vibrant colors. In the distance, nightlife patrons (blurred, smoking, talking, strolling) add authenticity without distracting focus.

Atmosphere: Stylish, raw, and intimidating yet elegant—echoing the cinematic aesthetic of Japanese gangster films and video games.

Camera Specs: Full-body perspective at eye level, captured with a full-frame camera using a 35mm prime lens at f/2.0. Subject is tack-sharp in focus, while the background remains softly blurred to create cinematic depth.

Post-Processing: Apply filmic color grading with neon accents, subtle grain, and high contrast to emphasize the texture of the suit. Enhance reflections on the wet ground, sharpen facial details, and keep skin tone and body proportions true to the source photo.

Output: 4:3 ratio, 8K resolution, with a glossy cinematic finish.
prompts.category: AI Portrait / Yakuza Style / Japanese Street / Cinematic / Fashion Editorial
prompts.tool: ChatGPT Image Generation / AI Photo Editing
prompts.note: Gunakan foto referensi dengan wajah yang jelas untuk menjaga kemiripan identitas. Ciptakan penampilan bos Yakuza bergaya film Jepang dengan setelan hitam elegan, kemeja putih terbuka tanpa dasi, tato irezumi naga dan koi yang terlihat samar, serta sepatu kulit hitam mengilap. Latar gang Kabukicho pada malam hari dengan lampu neon Jepang, jalanan basah, pantulan cahaya sinematik, dan latar belakang blur. Pertahankan anatomi realistis dan ekspresi wajah natural. Rasio 4:3, kualitas ultra-realistis.

Ensure the face exactly matches the provided reference selfie—keep the same eyes, nose, cheeks, and skin texture.

Hasil terbaik menggunakan pencahayaan natural, pose santai tetapi percaya diri, serta nuansa vintage sinematik. Cocok untuk personal branding, foto profil profesional, dan konten media sosial. Gunakan foto motor klasik hitam sebagai referensi tambahan jika tersedia.
